QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` wraps values in an empty `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r"(x))` on GNU-asm targets. The compiler cannot prove a condition's value, so it cannot turn a mask into a branch.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the empty asm volatile with the value as an in/out "+r" register operand, and says its purpose is to hide values from the optimiser so it cannot turn a mask into a branch (the optimisation-barrier role).
